question: Does the post-hoc RX J2129 amplitude bridge transfer without retuning when the A0279 baryonic center-return route is replayed on four other raw cluster lenses?

primary_hypothesis.selection_history: p=2.5 was the only descriptive RX J2129 bridge value to improve its held-out RMS, but it was not selected by RX J2129 training data; this is therefore an external replay of an explicitly post-hoc hypothesis
primary_hypothesis.gravity_budget: Only the P0554 lensing excess above the baryonic GR field is routed; the baryonic base remains local
primary_hypothesis.route_geometry: Each cataloged member launches a radial center-return path toward the member-light centroid; the map is converted to a curl-free deflection and its circular monopole is removed

systems.formula_use: A0279 and p=2.5 are locked for all four systems; neither subset selects a route parameter in this experiment
systems.within_family_split: Hold out the lexicographically last image in each family with at least three images; fit only six geometry nuisances and training-family source positions

member_sources.selection: finite RA, Dec and positive finite magnitude within 300 kpc; catalogs are the fixed Caminha/Lenstool member lists

route_to_deflection_translation.monopole_rule: subtract exact annular convergence mean and independently sampled circular radial deflection

sensitivity_scoring.method: At the frozen primary fit geometry and source positions, score each one-at-a-time variant on training and held-out images without a new fit
sensitivity_scoring.purpose: Measure local formula sensitivity; these rows cannot replace the primary

cross_scale_controls.reason_unchanged: The route correction has zero circular monopole and is absent for the axisymmetric galaxy and point-mass Solar controls

claim_limits: These four clusters are spent elsewhere in the project, but their image residuals have not selected A0279 or p=2.5.
The member catalogs omit intracluster gas and diffuse light, and were prepared for conventional lens models.
The zero-monopole construction tests angular routing only; it does not derive the scalar P0554 parent or a relativistic action.
The p=2.5 primary is explicitly post-hoc from RX J2129 and becomes credible only if it transfers here without change.
One-at-a-time variants are descriptive and cannot be promoted from this experiment.
